scope: Every formerly skipped local full-suite test is matched by its actual passing test name in the final full local log and current-code native Windows 2022 job log. This does not replace authenticated live Gemini acceptance.

tests.name: The audited official bundle with an initialized SQLite profile passes read-only preflight
The production installer rejects an uninitialized profile before lock, backup or settings writes
Malformed SQLite profiles reject before cancelling workers or writing setup state
A directory at state.vscdb rejects before cancelling workers or writing setup state
A SQLite file without ItemTable rejects before cancelling workers or writing setup state
Malformed managed Tab preferences reject before cancelling workers or writing setup state
Malformed agent policy types reject auto-approve before cancelling workers or writing setup state
Preflight validates only agent preferences managed by the requested scope
A supported production setup reaches its first lock write only after successful preflight
A supported production setup refuses a full disk before lock, backup, worker cancellation or profile writes
The actual audited official bundle matches the catalog and embedded schema
Linked native snapshot omits all account/unowned state and unified restore retains later personal rows
Completion-only linked quiet backup restores Tab and ghost text without parsing or rewriting chat
Bare-install MCP plus Tab rollback preserves later terminal/artifact choices it never owned
A native-only quiet backup with no editor files is listed and restored through the ordinary command
Quiet command cancels older all-scope work before its native-only linked backup and never touches chat
Native snapshot reads committed WAL and dry-run creates no snapshot or link
A later filesystem error reports that native restoration completed and file phase is partial
A real detached recovery uses its persisted compatibility catalog and applies only the saved completion scope
MCP-and-Tab rollback leaves later manual agent policies intact, including a second rollback of the inverse backup
